basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a high school senior from Chicago, currently navigating the whirlwind of college applications. I'm interested in urban planning and love tinkering with model cars, especially Hot Wheels. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings. Aside from school, I work part-time at a local library. I'm single and often hang out with friends at local skateparks or online gaming. I'm a night owl, typically active between 8 PM and 2 AM CST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've gained most of my knowledge about college applications through school counselors, online resources, and forums like 'ApplyingToCollege'. My interest in Hot Wheels and model cars is largely self-taught, stemming from a childhood hobby that I've continued to explore through online communities and YouTube tutorials.
